# EL CID Country Club

> Small rural hotel, restaurant and outdoor hospitality venue in Benidoleig, Marina Alta, Alicante, Spain.

## Canonical site
- https://www.elcidspain.com/

## Stay
- Double room with terrace.
- Family room.
- Independent studio with kitchen.
- Pool, terraces, tennis, hiking and cycling access are presented on the public site.
- Live availability, prices and final booking conditions must be confirmed through the booking option shown on the site.

## Food and gatherings
- The public site presents breakfast, day service, dinners and private tables.
- Service times are confirmed with the reservation.
- Private gatherings can be discussed using the public contact details on the site.
